meta.parties: Science House (Ceylon) Limited. v. I. P. A. Laboratories Private Limited

rules.statement: A company can file an affidavit through its recognized agent for a suit by way of summary procedure under Chapter LIII of the Civil Procedure Code.
rules.supporting_quote: "The plaintiff-company's attorney in Colombo was a 'recognised agent' within the meaning of S. 25 (b) of the Code and his affidavit was sufficient and satisfied the requirements of S. 705 (1) of the Code."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: S. 34 (1) of the Companies Ordinance, S. 705 (1) of the Civil Procedure Code
